proof_text:
have h₁ : (Swap (X) (Y) h_precond).fst = Y := by
    dsimp [Swap]
    <;> simp_all [Prod.fst]
    <;> aesop

  have h₂ : (Swap (X) (Y) h_precond).snd = X := by
    dsimp [Swap]
    <;> simp_all [Prod.snd]
    <;> aesop

  have h₃ : X ≠ Y → (Swap (X) (Y) h_precond).fst ≠ X ∧ (Swap (X) (Y) h_precond).snd ≠ Y := by
    intro h_ne
    dsimp [Swap] at *
    constructor <;> simp_all [Prod.fst, Prod.snd]
    <;>
    (try omega) <;>
    (try aesop) <;>
    (try
      {
        intro h
        apply h_ne
        <;> omega
      })

  dsimp [Swap_postcond, Swap_precond] at *
  <;> simp_all
  <;> aesop
